shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat rectangular slab
script-like signs / glyphic elements set in framed panels
bird form in profile (A: bird glyph; B: headdress with avian/plumed elements)
vertical columnar organization of the composition
enclosed cartouche/panel bounding a group of signs
justification: Both are shallow relief slabs organized into vertical registers with framed panels of writing-like signs, and both include a small profile bird-like form, but these are generic to monumental inscribed stone traditions. A is purely a sign-field with an oval enclosure around glyphs and repeated chevron/ladder bands, while B is dominated by a large standing human figure in profile-and-frontal mix with elaborate headdress standing over a crouching figure — no comparable human scene exists in A.
